effect_zh: 第 11 步兵团是继续战争期间（1941 年至 1944 年）芬兰陆军第 3 师的一个单位。1941 年，该师参加了北极狐行动，这是德芬军队对在芬兰拉普兰北部萨拉市的苏联防御展开的联合进攻。北极狐行动是代号为“银狐”的大型军事行动的一部分，该行动旨在占领摩尔曼斯克港口。尽管他们成功占领了萨拉，但仍并未达到预期目标，双方均在自己的阵地上挖掘战壕，行动最终于 1941 年 11 月结束。1944 年，第 3 师被派往卡累利阿地峡，参与芬兰对苏联维堡 - 彼得罗扎沃茨克攻势的防御，苏联军队设法占领了东卡累利阿和南卡累利阿地峡。莫斯科停战协定签署后（1944 年 9 月 19 日），该师参加了与德国的拉普兰战争，直到 1944 年 10 月解散。
effect_source: The 11th Infantry Regiment was a unit of the 3rd Division of the Finnish Army during the Continuation War (1941 to 1944). In 1941 the division participated in Operation Arctic Fox which was a joint offensive by German and Finnish forces against the Soviet defenses at Salla, a municipality located in northern Finnish Lapland. Operation Arctic Fox was part of a larger operation codenamed Operation Silver Fox, which aimed to capture the port of Murmansk. Even though they managed to capture Salla, the operation did not meet its goal and it ended in November 1941 when both sides dug in at their positions. In 1944, the 3rd Division was sent to the Karelian Isthmus, engaging in Finland's defense against the Soviet Vyborg–Petrozavodsk offensive where the Soviets forces managed to capture East Karelia and southern Karelian Isthmus. After the Moscow Armistice (19 September 1944), the division fought in the Lapland War against Germany until it was disbanded in October 1944.
